manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Yannik, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Lagrella enters the battlefield, exiling Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Yannik to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling Lagrella and distributing two +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone.
Lagrella leaves the battlefield, causing Phantom Steed to be returned to the battlefield from exile with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, exiling Yannik.
Yannik leaves the battlefield, causing Lagrella to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Yannik until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lagrella until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
